lore: <gray>Having one of these mysterious shining charms makes it more likely you'll encounter Shiny Pokémon in the wild.
<gray>This charm hums with a faint energy that seems to quicken the growth of any Pokémon that battles by your side.
<gray>This charm is said to help you notice the subtle traits that set apart Pokémon with rare, hidden abilities.
<gray>Carrying this charm seems to sharpen the effort your Pokémon put into every battle, letting their training take root faster.
<gray>This charm is said to resonate with a Pokémon's innate potential, increasing the odds of encountering exceptionally gifted individuals.
<gray>A faint scent of ripening fruit clings to this charm, encouraging berry trees around you to yield more of their bounty.
<gray>This charm seems to calm wild Pokémon ever so slightly, making them easier to catch.
<gray>Those who carry this charm report crossing paths with Pokémon bearing unusual marks far more often than most trainers do.
<gray>A primal energy radiates from this charm, said to draw the attention of towering Alpha Pokémon roaming the wilds.
<gray>This charm seems to stir the natural balance of an area, coaxing a greater variety of Pokémon out from hiding.
